title: lowendaff-bench Dedicated Server JSON Report (v0.1.5)
description: Structured JSON report emitted by `lowendaff-bench --format json` (`-f json`) on a dedicated physical server (`system.platform.kind == "dedicated"`).

environment.description: Localized dedicated server summary (e.g. 'no virtualization detected').

show_ip.description: Whether unmasked public IPs, prefixes, and hostnames were preserved.

runs.description: Ordered results for every selected plugin applicable to the server (all 16 plugins eligible, including `disk.health` and `memory.numa`).

items.description: Localized display title of a non-applicable plugin (e.g. 'Memory NUMA' on single-node hosts).

not_applicable.description: Localized display titles of selected plugins omitted because they do not apply to this server.

items.description: Total scheduled items in this run.

skipped.description: Items skipped because preconditions were unmet.

timed_out.description: Items stopped after exceeding their timeout.

total_seconds.description: Wall-clock duration across all items in seconds.

Summary.description: Aggregate item counts and wall-clock runtime.

Platform.description: Dedicated bare-metal server (`kind == 'dedicated'`, no hypervisor or container).

Libc.description: Host C library detection used for prebuilt tool compatibility.

HardwareFacts.description: Physical machine, board, firmware, BMC, ECC, and SMBIOS slot inventory (dedicated only).

quota.description: Always null on dedicated servers (cgroup CPU quota applies to containers only).

sockets.description: Physical CPU socket count when topology is readable.

cores.description: Total physical CPU core count when topology is readable.

virtualization.description: Hardware virtualization state (`intel_vt_x`, `amd_v`, `absent`, or `not_applicable` on non-x86).

CpuFacts.description: Dedicated physical server CPU profile including socket/core topology.

raid.description: Hardware RAID/HBA controllers and attached member disks (empty array when none present).

StorageFacts.description: Dedicated server storage profile with physical disks, rotational flags, and RAID inventory.

uptime_from_host.description: False when uptime_seconds is present, null when unreadable (never true on bare metal).

load_from_host.description: False when load is present, null when unreadable (never true on bare metal).

OsFacts.description: Operating system and kernel parameters on a dedicated server.

public_address.description: Full IP when show_ip is true, else masked.

hardware.description: Physical machine, motherboard, BIOS/UEFI/U-Boot firmware, IPMI/BMC, ECC/EDAC, and SMBIOS DIMM slots (always collected on dedicated servers).

SystemSection.description: Dedicated physical server hardware, OS, storage, and network profile.

JobAdjustment.description: OOM score adjustment status from bench_tool::job::Adjustment.

TextNumber.description: Numeric measurement paired with its exact formatted text.

CpuBenchOutput.description: Unified output for cpu.bench across all selected CPU sub-suites.

MemoryStreamOutput.description: Output of memory.stream (Copy, Scale, Add, Triad).

MemoryLatencyOutput.description: Output of memory.latency (multichase cache & DRAM latency).

MemoryNumaOutput.description: Output of memory.numa cross-node bandwidth & latency matrix.

DiskFioOutput.description: Output of disk.fio (4k / 64k / 512k / 1m mixed random I/O).

client_ip.description: Full IP when show_ip is true, else masked.

prefixItems.description: true when IPv6, false when IPv4.

NetworkTcpingTarget.description: Single probed (target, family) record in network.tcping.

NetworkTcpingOutput.description: Output of network.tcping (unprivileged dual-stack TCP handshake latency, jitter, P95, and loss).

address.description: Router hop IP (masked if matching host's public IP unless show_ip).
Public IP when show_ip is true, else masked.

prefix.description: CIDR prefix when show_ip is true, else masked prefix.

svg.description: Inline BGP topology SVG rendered by the JSON reporter.

prefixItems.description: true when IPv6, false when IPv4.

NetworkBgpOutput.description: Output of network.bgp (RIPEstat BGP paths + RPKI + inline topology SVG).

address.description: Public IP when show_ip is true, else masked.

hostname.description: Shown only when show_ip is true, else null.

IpQualityOutput.description: Output of ip.quality (multi-source IP reputation, DNSBL, and port-25 checks).

IpMediaOutput.description: Output of ip.media (streaming media unlock checks across IPv4 and IPv6).

started_seconds.description: Start offset in seconds from benchmark start.

Run.description: Single benchmark plugin execution record; output schema is discriminated by id.
